sources.title: Jobs Overview · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jobs offers a Docker-like interface to rub Jobs, where you can specify a Docker image from Hugging Face Spaces or Docker Hub, as well as the command to run. Docker provides the ability to package ready-to-use environments as Docker images that are shared by the community or custom made.

sources.title: GitHub - lhoestq/hfjobs: Hugging Face Jobs
sources.snippet: Run compute jobs on Hugging Face infrastructure with a familiar Docker-like interface! hfjobs is a command-line tool that lets you run anything on Hugging Face's infrastructure (including GPUs and TPUs!) with simple commands. Think docker run, but for running code on A100s.

sources.title: Docker Model Runner
sources.snippet: Designed for developers, Docker Model Runner streamlines the process of pulling, running, and serving large language models (LLMs) and other AI models directly from Docker Hub, any OCI-compliant registry, or Hugging Face.
